## WorkerThreadRpc.estimatePayloadSize() method

Estimate the in-memory footprint of a structured value.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static estimatePayloadSize(value: unknown): number;
```

Estimated size in bytes.

## Remarks

Recursive walker that counts strings, numbers, buffer bytes and keys with bounded double-count-avoidance. It deliberately does not serialize (`JSON.stringify` throws on `BigInt`<!-- -->, which messagepack payloads can contain), so we approximate the size the value occupies after decode.

Static because it depends on no instance state — the gateway server uses it to decide whether a response is worth caching for duplicate suppression.
